narration.text: A tester's unclaimed property is claimed free from two states under both her names: a refund under her married name at an old address, two checks and a dividend under her own, a premium refund and a policy a finder wanted a quarter of, while three namesakes, an ex-husband's, a company's, a paid one and her dead mother's are left alone. This is a chore for a software tester in Portland, Oregon, who lived in Chicago and Burlington under her married name and her own, and gets a letter from a finder. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 1,016 dollars and 43 cents of the 1,016 dollars and 43 cents there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 8 traps, and she walked past 8. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 50 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
